decision.covered_scope: Removal of 12 to 15 cubic yards of flood-borne stones from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building in the yard
decision.evidence_needed: Additional evidence that the estimated dollar amount from the contractor is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors
decision.excluded_scope: Transportation by barge, handling, disposal, and any increased cost to remove non-owned debris in the yard or cart debris from the perimeter into a barge
decision.prior_claim_check: Verify documentation for previous claims with debris removal to ensure no payment overlap; verify debris removal for the same area was performed before the July 2019 flood event

findings.evidence: FEMA agrees SFIP covers cost to remove flood-borne debris such as stones deposited underneath the insured building's perimeter footprint
findings.title: Coverage for Debris Removal Underneath Building

findings.evidence: SFIP does not cover expense to dispose non-owned debris because it is not insured property; excludes barge transportation, handling, and disposal
findings.title: Exclusion of Transport and Disposal Costs

findings.evidence: Contractor quoted $3,564 per cubic yard with sales tax; FEMA recommends providing other debris removal estimates from different contractors to validate reasonableness
findings.title: Price Support Requirements

findings.evidence: Policyholder filed three prior flood claims in May and June 2019; must provide proof of repairs and price from previous losses related to removing stones and debris from underneath the building
findings.title: Prior Claim Overlap Verification

headline: FEMA Flood Insurance Appeal Decision B8: Partial Coverage for Debris Removal Under Insured Building
next_actions: Insurer to review policyholder's amended proof of loss totaling $182,552.00
Insurer to verify coverage for direct physical loss by or from flood to covered property
Insurer to confirm excluded costs (transport, handling, disposal) are not covered under SFIP
Insurer to request additional evidence regarding contractor pricing and prior claim history
Insurer to issue payment only for covered scope of work (removal underneath building)
Insurer to deny transport, handling, and disposal components of the claim
